Results.ReviewText: I have always wanted one of these original kettle grills. I had an opportunity to get one of these as an award and I did. I love this grill. These grills are top quality. One of the things that has always impressed me about these kettle grills is how evenly they cook. They are so consistent and you don't have to worry about making sure they are perfectly level like you do a gas grill. There are no cold spots unless you want one. All have to do is arrange you charcoal. In short I am really enjoying this thing.
Results.Title: Quality and ease of use.

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd Weber Kettle. My first one lasted 20+ years. I'll be leaving this grill to my son.

Results.ReviewText: Don’t get me wrong it’s a good little grill. I’ve used it to smoke ribs and cook burgers on multiple occasions and everything has come out amazing! But there a couple of improvements that would make this even better, especially for the price. Have a thermometer on the side of the vent, have a something on the top vent so you can grab it cause it gets hot. Things that they could add on this without hiking up the price too much. But it’s a good starter grill. Weber just needs to realize there is competition out there with good prices and all updated features.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are very sorry to learn that your grill's lid is not sealing properly. This is not normal and we would never expect you to use a grill that is out of round. Your grill's warranty covers an issue like this and we will be happy to assist you.

We do not expect our grills to form a perfect seal. New grills will leak more smoke as they develop a stronger seal over time. It is possible that your grill is normal, but we want to help make sure!

Please look for an email outreach from our Support team soon. Thank you!
